Remove its 95 hidden triangles: faces inside another part or pressed face to face, never seen.
15 round part(s) (cylinders, prisms): thin ones as boxes without caps or 3-sided prisms and the fake rounded-corner shader; caps that touch another part left out.
36 bytes a vertex: quantize (position 3 x int16, normal as 2 x int8 octahedral, colour 4 x uint8): about 12-16 bytes (KHR_mesh_quantization).
